description: This file is a server-side PHP script that generates a web page for configuring SIP Basic Setup for a VoIP service provider. It includes PHP logic to fetch current configuration values, HTML form elements for user input, and JavaScript for dynamic interactions and AJAX requests to apply configuration changes.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: A PHP function that retrieves current SIP configuration values using the getStr() function, returning an associative array of key-value pairs.
